build_GroundingHead: build a GroundingHead module with a decoder config and tokenizer for visual grounding tasks
run_GroundingHead_forward: run the GroundingHead forward pass with text embeddings and encoder hidden states to predict bounding boxes
calculate_GroundingHead_loss: calculate the grounding loss with L1 and GIoU weighting using decoder targets and encoder features
predict_GroundingHead_bbox: predict bounding box coordinates at inference time using autoregressive decoding over four steps
process_GroundingHead_bbox: process raw bbox token IDs into normalized xyxy coordinates clipped to the 0-1 range
